profile_text.body:
Zhejiang University, abbreviated ZJU, is a university lab headquartered in Hangzhou, China, and is not a for-profit entity. Its website content includes listings for academic talks on its campuses.

One listed talk features Robert West, described as Emeritus Professor of Health Psychology at University College London, founder of PRIME Theory of Motivation, and a co-creator of the COM-B model and the Behaviour Change Wheel. Another talk by Sophia Bano covers recent advancements in artificial intelligence and surgical data science, which the abstract says are driving AI-assisted robotic surgery in imaging, surgical navigation, and robotic intervention.

No products or litigation are listed for the university.
